architectures.name: Microservice Architecture
architectures.description: A scalable microservice architecture using AWS services

components.name: Amazon CloudFront
components.brief: Global content delivery network (CDN) that caches and serves content from edge locations worldwide for low latency

components.name: Amazon S3
components.brief: Object storage service for static assets like images, CSS, JavaScript, and backups

components.name: Application Load Balancer
components.brief: Distributes incoming HTTP/HTTPS traffic across multiple targets (ECS tasks) for high availability

components.name: Amazon ECS
components.brief: Container orchestration service that runs and manages Docker containers at scale

components.name: Amazon ElastiCache
components.brief: In-memory caching service (Redis/Memcached) for fast data access and session storage

components.name: Amazon Aurora
components.brief: MySQL and PostgreSQL-compatible relational database with auto-scaling and high availability

components.name: Amazon DynamoDB
components.brief: NoSQL database service for flexible schema and single-digit millisecond latency at any scale

architectures.name: AWS Management Architecture
architectures.description: Infrastructure automation with EC2, Systems Manager, and serverless Lambda

components.name: Amazon EC2 Instances
components.brief: Virtual servers running applications with customizable compute, memory, and storage

components.name: AWS Systems Manager
components.brief: Centralized service for viewing and controlling AWS infrastructure, automating tasks and patching

components.name: Amazon S3
components.brief: Object storage for logs, documents, and automation scripts with unlimited scalability

components.name: AWS Lambda
components.brief: Serverless compute that runs code in response to events without managing servers
